experimental_market_breadth_guard.method: mean daily fraction of the captured current roster with positive close-to-close returns

experimental_turnover_controlled_consens.method: buy at the top-N consensus threshold and retain until rank exceeds the wider hold threshold; emergency exits remain unchanged

experimental_consensus_rank_exit_ablatio.method: same consensus entries and damage-control exits with daily cross-sectional rank decay disabled; maximum hold remains 21 sessions

portfolio_concentration_policy.selection_policy: preserve raw signal order; do not replace a sector-capped name with a lower-ranked candidate
